result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: unreadable promo banner due to low contrast, heavily blurred restaurant images that look broken, and truncated restaurant name at the carousel edge.

issues.description: Promotional banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext in white on very light mint background has extremely low contrast and is nearly unreadable
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color or darker background to meet WCAG contrast requirements for readability

issues.description: All restaurant cover images in 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' sections appear heavily blurred, pixelated and out of focus as if low-resolution placeholders failed to load
issues.suggestion: Ensure high-resolution images are loaded correctly and replace blurry placeholders with sharp images

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off at the screen edge without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Add proper text truncation with ellipsis or ensure card width and padding prevent mid-character cutoff
